crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software development grounds AI-system implementation but does not define safety/risk evaluation.

crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data-science work contributes model evaluation/analysis while acceptable-risk and governance remain distinct.

findings.summary: AI Safety has no clean one-code occupational identity in O*NET; it draws on software/model work but requires a dedicated risk/evaluation boundary and must not acquire governance or deployment authority from that specialization.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialization boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make bounded safety evaluation, residual risk, risk acceptance and deployment/legal authority separate evidence/decision surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Ai Safety Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, platform, security, product or institutional authority is created.
